eyebrow: Same app, three environments, one pile of YAML

steps.label: Drift
steps.sub: an image tag updated in staging, forgotten in production

steps.label: No atomic rollback
steps.sub: reverting means finding and reapplying old YAML by hand

steps.label: No record of what's running
steps.sub: no single source of truth for current configuration

code:
helm repo add northbridgeretail https://charts.northbridgeretail.internal
helm repo update

helm install catalog northbridgeretail/product-catalog \
  --values values-prod.yaml

helm upgrade catalog northbridgeretail/product-catalog \
  --set image.tag=1.6.0

helm rollback catalog 1
helm list
caption: Every install or upgrade becomes a numbered revision — rollback is one command, not a YAML hunt.

subtitle: Building this exact chart for product-catalog, piece by piece.
